prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Oct28–31 key with original provenance.

limits: The two-part header and consecutive labels establish the family. Both native lengths match the visible source exactly.
The raw strings require zero coordinate edits, fills or frame changes. The edited layer is deliberately identical.
AUSLANDESMITTELN is displayed as aus Landesmitteln; it is not silently changed to Auslandsmitteln.
All reference numbers and the literal phrase OKTOBER18 remain unchanged. The message orders payments to stop and offices to be notified; it does not establish that either action was carried out.
Both exact bodies existed in earlier unreviewed repository candidates. Source inspection and exact reproduction are new work; no historical first-solution claim is made.
